stats.ds1-stats.help.39dc3032.text: Like a number of data values in starting class data, this is a redundant value normally set somewhere else that all starter classes have as zero. Not sure if this field is even used, but edit at your own risk. ~Lex
stats.ds1-stats.help.504c3aca.text: Like a number of data values in starting class data, this is a redundant value normally set somewhere else that all starter classes have as zero. Stamina recovery specifically I think is hardcoded in the .exe itself. Not sure if this field is even used, but edit at your own risk. ~Lex
stats.ds1-stats.help.585f5792.text: Exactly what it says on the tin. Zero for all starting classes, though I assume nonzero values would work seeing as this field gets used in Bloodborne IIRC. Haven't given it a try, though. ~Lex
stats.ds1-stats.help.5a572fd9.text: Fall damage reduction, presumably. Like a number of data values in starting class data, this is a redundant value normally set somewhere else that all starter classes have as zero. Not sure if this field is even used, but edit at your own risk. ~Lex
stats.ds1-stats.help.677c8cd.text: Not sure what this field actually does or why it's here, considering your HP is a derived value based on your attributes. 0 for all starting classes, change at your own risk. ~Lex
stats.ds1-stats.help.6de37289.text: Presumably a holdover from Demon's Souls, but extra useless now, considering it's a derived value based on your attributes. 0 for all starting classes, change at your own risk. ~Lex
stats.ds1-stats.help.aa742322.text: -1 for all classes. Presumably unused, but would probably make a good mystery for a Zullie the Witch or Lance McDonald video. My best guess is that it did something back in DeS. ~Lex
stats.ds1-stats.help.b00e3974.text: Starting soul level. Not actually a combination of your total stats or an average or anything like that, as far as I can tell it's totally arbitrary. ~Lex
stats.ds1-stats.help.b078367c.text: The most important stat in the game. ~Lex
stats.ds1-stats.help.b18f5abb.text: Not sure what this field actually does or why it's here, considering your Stamina is a derived value based on your attributes. 0 for all starting classes, change at your own risk. ~Lex
stats.ds1-stats.help.d631bec5.text: Why is this here considering you can set your sex independently of your class in the character creator? Your guess is as good as mine. ~Lex
stats.ds1-stats.help.f75c5910.text: The covenant your character will be in when you start the game. ~Lex
